confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with event calendars and Riverwalk-area demand in July. The FX observation came from a search summary that reported the RBA homepage figure; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Texas and Sunbelt US cities with comparable tourism profiles, such as Austin and Houston, adjusted for San Antonio's lower overall price level and Riverwalk-area tourist demand. Drink anchors use the typical US beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine relationship where direct knowledge is weaker.
